name: T-Mobile US, Inc.
description: T-Mobile US is a single-segment wireless carrier (it does not break out Consumer/Business the way Verizon and AT&T do) offering postpaid and prepaid mobile service nationwide, plus a fast-growing 5G Home Internet fixed-wireless broadband product. T-Mobile has expanded into wireline fiber broadband not by building or buying networks outright but through 50/50 joint ventures with private-equity partners (Lumos with EQT, closed April 2025; Metronet with KKR, closed July 2025), and closed its ~$4.4 billion acquisition of United States Cellular's wireless operations, transferring most of UScellular's subscribers, retail stores and about 30% of its spectrum holdings to T-Mobile.
